subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and hosting profiles

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the full contract in this PR: canonical conditions, four built-in profiles, operator-composed profiles, three profile-selection surfaces, and a public plugin readiness callback API?
rationale: This establishes permanent product, availability, configuration, startup, and external plugin SDK behavior; implementation quality cannot decide that direction without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Adopt canonical projection of existing Gateway readiness and the thin CLI first, while deferring hosting profiles and plugin callbacks to separately approved follow-up work.

options.title: Approve the full RFC
options.body: Accept all proposed contracts after the workspace defect is fixed and exact-head packaged fresh-install and upgrade proof is attached.

options.title: Pause the implementation
options.body: Keep the branch draft until maintainers choose a different readiness or hosting ownership model.

recommendation.title: Narrow the first release
recommendation.body: Adopt canonical projection of existing Gateway readiness and the thin CLI first, while deferring hosting profiles and plugin callbacks to separately approved follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the existing Gateway readiness owner, configuration behavior, and Docker validation surface.
